label: GB-dpa-2018 Section 133

obligations.text:
Guidance about privileged communications
(1)
The Commission must produce and publish guidance about—
(a)
how the Commission proposes to secure that privileged communications which the Commission obtains or has access to in the course of carrying out the Commission's functions are used or disclosed only so far as necessary for carrying out those functions, and
(b)
how the Commission proposes to comply with restrictions and prohibitions on obtaining or having access to privileged communications which are imposed by an enactment.

(2)
The Commission—
(a)
may alter or replace the guidance, and
(b)
must publish any altered or replacement guidance.

(3)
The Commission must consult the Secretary of State before publishing guidance under this section (including altered or replacement guidance).

(4)
The Commission must arrange for guidance under this section (including altered or replacement guidance) to be laid before Parliament.
